title: Computable two-sided error bounds on the specific absorption rate in full-wave dosimetry: source code
description: Source code for the manuscript 'Computable two-sided error bounds on the specific absorption rate in full-wave dosimetry: a goal-oriented framework validated in one, two and three dimensions' (H. Talleb, Physics in Medicine & Biology, PMB-122013, revision R1): full-wave edge-element dosimetry and goal-oriented two-sided bounds on the absorbed power and on the peak 10 g spatial-average SAR in one, two and three dimensions.
